name.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Fort St. John BC

description.value: A Super 8 by Wyndham franchise motel located on Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, a major service centre near the start of the Alaska Highway. For northbound touring cyclists, Fort St. John represents one of the last substantial urban stops before the more remote stretches of the highway corridor. The property participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.

address.value: 9500 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, BC
